question: Who among the following secured one of the two silver medals for India at the Tokyo Olympics 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Ravi Kumar Dahiya.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya**

 
 
• **​**Ravi Kumar Dahiya is an** Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• He won a** silver medal** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics **in the **57 kg** category.
 
• Dahiya is also a **bronze medallist** from** the 2019 World Wrestling Championships** and a three-time Asian champion.
 
• **In the 2022 Birmingham Commonwealth Games**, he won the **gold medal** in the men's** 57 kg** freestyle wrestling category.
 
• He was **ranked fifth **at the 2019 Asian Wrestling Championships in Xi'an.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sushil Kumar**

 
 
• Sushil Kumar Solanki is a **former Indian wrestler.**
 
• He carried the Indian flag at the opening ceremony of the 2012 London Olympics. 
 
• In **July 2009**, he received the** Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna.**
 
• Sushil won the gold medal in the 74 kg division at the 2014 Commonwealth games.
 
 
 
• **Bajrang Punia**
 
 
• Bajrang Punia is an** Indian freestyle wrestler.**
 
• He competes in the** 65-kg **weight category.
 
• At the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, Punia won a bronze medal.
 
• Punia is the only Indian wrestler to win 3 medals at the World Wrestling Championships.
 
 
 
• **KD Jadhav**
 
 
• **​**Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav was an **Indian athlete.**
 
• He is best known as a wrestler who won a** bronze medal** at the **1952 Summer Olympics** in Helsinki.
 
• He was the first athlete from independent India to win an individual medal in the Olympics.
 
 

dc:T
